Sure, here’s an example of a negative Amazon review for a foam mattress:

---

I regret buying this foam mattress. It started off feeling comfortable for the first week, but then it started sagging in the middle, making it impossible to get a good night’s sleep. The advertised "cooling gel" doesn’t work at all—it sleeps hotter than any mattress I’ve ever owned. The chemical smell when I first unpacked it was overwhelming and took weeks to fade. Despite the claims of being "pressure-relieving," my back and hips ache every morning. The edges of the mattress are so flimsy that sitting on the side feels like I’ll slide right off. Customer service has been unhelpful, refusing to honor the warranty, so now I’m stuck with this overpriced mess. Save yourself the hassle and invest in a better product.

---
